svg.aria-label: A browser reaches NGINX on an EC2 instance over HTTPS; NGINX proxies to Apache. certbot on the instance gets the certificate from the ACM ACME endpoint, which approved the domain through a Route 53 CNAME. Below, an ALB and an NLB end TLS with a regular ACM certificate and forward to a plain HTTP backend and to a backend with an expired self-signed certificate
